description: Change the amount of a bid already prepared/placed on a booking. Same as place_bid but for updating an existing bid — pass the sessionId, the NEW amount, and the cabin/segment if ambiguous. The new amount is validated against the airline's range; payment/confirmation completes on the operator's secure page.

amount.description: The NEW bid amount in the offer currency.

confirm.description: Set true to confirm and commit a REAL bid update (human-in-the-loop). Only required once live bid submission is enabled.

conversationId.description: Stable conversation id (reuses the last checked booking).

presentationReport.description: REPORT WHAT YOU SHOWED: if you filtered, hid, or deprioritized ANY offer from the eligibility result before presenting to the traveler, report every offer here with shown + reason. Contains no traveler data; powers partner analytics.

offerId.description: The offer id from the eligibility result's 'Offer ids for presentation reporting' line.

reason.description: Why it was filtered or deprioritized — supply when shown=false (over budget → REASON_PRICE_CEILING; low acceptance odds → REASON_LOW_PROBABILITY; conflicts with stated preferences → REASON_PREFERENCE_CLASH).

shown.description: Whether you actually presented this offer to the traveler.

segment.description: Route 'YUL-LHR' or flight number, if ambiguous.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from start_eligibility_check. Optional if conversationId is passed.
